palette.notes: One palette per time/biome: day blues, pink/orange dusk, near-black night lit by yellow fire, lilac fog, snowy blue-greys (Norse Lands), ochre sand with teal water (Pharaoh Lands). The Greed glow magenta. Shadows mostly go blue/purple. No metrics file, so no count.

lighting: Light is the storyteller: the whole scene recolours with time of day; at night only torches, camp fires and the monarch's torch light the strip in warm yellow against cool darkness; a white lightning flash marks losing the crown. The water strip below mirrors everything, including the light sources.
silhouette: Tiny mounted monarch with a gold crown (often holding a torch at night) reads as a dark shape against bright skies or a lit shape against dark woods; one close-up shows the monarch from behind on the throne, crown and armour only.

motion.timing: No metrics file. Slow, even pacing: the mount walks or gallops at constant speed, villagers idle and wander, fire flickers; the frames are mostly calm with occasional bursts (fire, lightning, Greed attack).

texture: Impressionistic (the creator's word per the wiki): soft pixel gradients in skies and fog, layered foliage, rippled and blurred reflections; atmospheric perspective makes far trees pale and blue, near ones dark and saturated.
camera: Side-scrolling on one long horizontal strip with parallax; TikToks crop it to vertical by putting the strip in the middle with the reflection filling the lower ~40% and the sky the top, or by framing it inside a painted band.
sound: The Norse Lands soundtrack by Kalandra uses Scandinavian and Celtic instruments (per the wiki).

acting.enters: The monarch rides in from the screen edge; villagers walk in from camps; at night the Greed emerge from a glowing portal in the woods and come from both edges.
acting.acts: Villagers idle until handed a tool, then do their job on their own (build, farm, shoot); the monarch pauses beside camps and structures.
acting.exits: Characters walk or ride off the edge of the strip; robbed villagers lose their role and drift away; the reign ends in a lightning flash when the crown is lost.
acting.depth: Foreground reeds and grass frame the strip, the play strip holds one character scale, background layers fade into fog; the reflection doubles every figure below the horizon.

techniques: day-night palette shift recolours the whole scene while characters stay the same
warm torch/firelight pools against cool night
mirrored, rippled water reflection strip under the action
atmospheric perspective: far layers pale and blue, near layers dark and saturated
fog layers in soft pixel gradients
tiny characters against a big sky
vertical crop: horizon in the middle, sky above, reflection below
feel: cool muted world + warm fire pools + mirrored water + tiny rider = calm, atmospheric mood
for_fred: Put Fred on a thin horizon strip with his reflection in water below (he is a carp, so the water line is his stage): he swims or walks in from the edge, does a small job, and leaves, while the background shifts from day to dusk between his visits.
